content:
Let the bottom-left corner of the grid be \((0,0)\). Since each grid square has area \(1\), the grid spacing is \(1\).

The shaded polygon has vertices
\[
(0,0),\quad (2,3),\quad (5,4),\quad (5,0).
\]

Draw the diagonal from \((0,0)\) to \((5,4)\), dividing the polygon into two triangles.

1. The triangle with vertices \((0,0),(5,0),(5,4)\) has area
\[
\frac12(5)(4)=10.
\]

2. The triangle with vertices \((0,0),(2,3),(5,4)\) has area
\[
\frac12\left|\det
\begin{pmatrix}
2&3\\
5&4
\end{pmatrix}\right|
=\frac12|2(4)-3(5)|
=\frac72.
\]

Thus the total shaded area is
\[
10+\frac72=\boxed{\frac{27}{2}}.
\]
